name: Samsung Galaxy A17 5G (Demo Unit)
shortDescription: Open-box demo (display) unit of the Samsung Galaxy A17 5G. It has a 16.91 cm (6.7 inch) 90 Hz Super AMOLED display, 50 MP main camera with OIS and 5,000 mAh battery.
description:
This is a demo (display) unit of the Samsung Galaxy A17 5G that was used for in-store demonstration, sold open-box at a lower price. It may show light signs of handling. Please contact us before ordering if you'd like to know its exact condition, the accessories included and the remaining manufacturer warranty.

The Samsung Galaxy A17 5G has a 16.91 cm (6.7 inch) FHD+ Super AMOLED display with a refresh rate of up to 90 Hz and Corning Gorilla Glass Victus on the front. It has an octa-core processor (2.4 GHz + 2 GHz) with 6 GB or 8 GB RAM and 128 GB or 256 GB storage, and takes a microSD card of up to 2 TB.

There are three rear cameras (50 MP with OIS, 5 MP and 2 MP) and a 13 MP front camera. The phone has a 5,000 mAh battery (typical) and an IP54 rating for dust and splash resistance.

Samsung lists six generations of OS upgrades and six years of security updates for this model, with security updates until 31 August 2031.
